topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic welcomes the students and frames complement within the broader context of the course.

topics.label: Foundational architecture of the complement cascade
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the basic organization and operating principles of the complement cascade.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the three recognition pathways that trigger complement activation by depositing C3b on pathogen surfaces.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the effector mechanisms through which activated complement eliminates pathogens.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how regulatory proteins prevent complement activation on host tissues.

topics.label: Clinical complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the distinct disease presentations and vulnerabilities resulting from deficiencies in complement proteins.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the strategies evolved by pathogens to evade complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Lecture closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks and previews the upcoming lecture on the adaptive immune system.
